title: #217 bar 2: fledge run flake-window computes the two-week clean window from CI history, flake issues and bug records, read-only, as a receipt with a clean, running or blocked verdict
description: #217 bar 2: fledge run flake-window computes the two-week clean window from CI history, flake issues and bug records, read-only, as a receipt with a clean, running or blocked verdict
acceptance_criteria: fledge run flake-window prints one JSON receipt and writes nothing: clean after 14 days of green main CI on macOS and Linux with no rerun and no open flake; running, naming the latest restart and when it can first be clean, after a red or skipped main run, a rerun on any branch, a filed flake or a day without a green main run on either OS; blocked while a flake issue or DRIVE-19 bug is open, a closed flake has no green main run since, or a flake issue has no bug record; exit 2 and never clean when GitHub cannot be read in full (red then green in .github/scripts/test-flake-window.py)

answers.constraints: specs/cli/cli.3md: hosted CI runners have no Git identity, so the fixtures never commit; FLOW-10 and FLOW-16: the check records no human decision; LIFE-19: the release records the receipt as a short evidence entry, the raw input stays out of Git
